PROJECTION MAY SUPPRESS ONLY AS EXPLICIT RESIDUE
AUTHORITY CANNOT INCREASE THROUGH A VIEW
RETURN RESTORES CONTEXT; ROLLBACK IS A SEPARATE OPERATION
PHYSICAL RENDERING IS NOT PHYSICAL TRUTH

current_model.plain: Keep each thing where it really lives. Give it stable addresses and semantic facets. Project those facets into ordinary page/ring/room/glyph/etc at different scales. Let operations change the host only through explicit support/authority. Keep one or many focus pointers and exact RETURN.

transform_distinctions.project: facet -> visible allocation/geometry/LOD; identity-preserving unless explicit transform

current_model.operation_square: PROJECT(OP(host)) ~= VIEW_OP(PROJECT(host)) for operations claimed equivalent

do_not_do: Do not build a new universal dashboard/product.

Do not merge domain semantics merely because projections look similar.
Do not turn six offices, rings, cubes or triangles into mandatory ontology.
Do not demote/delete donors until unique residue round-trips and lived use confirms replacement.
Do not let recovery workers redesign or silently merge artifacts.
Do not confuse RETURN with undo or rollback.
Do not let projection grant send/spend/delete/actuate authority.
